sourceTitle: A serious proposal to the Ladies, for the advancement of their true and greatest interest (In Two Parts)
description: "A Serious Proposal to the Ladies" by a Lover of her Sex is a treatise aimed at promoting the intellectual and moral advancement of women, written in the late 17th century. The text advocates for a transformative education that shifts women's focus from superficial charms to the cultivation of their minds and virtues, urging them to transcend societal expectations that limit their potential.
